bottled-water.title: Bottled Water Production Line
bottled-water.description: This fully integrated production line is engineered for the hygienic, sustainable, and cost-effective manufacturing of bottled water in PET containers, combining bottle blowing system with advanced water treatment, high-speed filling, labeling, coding, and packaging.
features: High-speed filling up to 20,000 bottles per hour
Integrated blow molding for PET bottles

carbonated.title: Carbonated Drink Production Line
carbonated.description: This advanced production line delivers a full-service solution for producing carbonated drinks in PET, glass bottles, or cans, equipped with integrated blow molding system for PET formats, precision carbonation, and robust packaging systems.
features: Supports PET, glass, and can formats
Integrated blow molding for PET bottles

barrel-water.title: Barrel Water Production Line
barrel-water.description: This production line is purpose-built for the hygienic and efficient bottling of the 19-litre water barrels—widely used with water dispensers in homes, offices, and commercial settings.

dairy.title: Dairy Milk Production Line
dairy.description: This dairy milk production line is engineered for the efficient, hygienic, and high-volume processing of fresh and long-life milk. It provides a fully integrated system from raw milk reception to final packaging.

juice.title: Juice Production Line
juice.description: This high-performance juice production line is designed for the efficient, hygienic, and cost-effective manufacturing of fruit juices, nectars, and juice-based drinks.

edible-oil.title: Edible Oil Filling Machines
edible-oil.description: Our edible oil filling machines are purpose-built for accurate, clean, and efficient dispensing of all types of edible oils—including vegetable oil, palm oil, sunflower oil, soybean oil, groundnut oil, and specialty oils.
features: Suitable for startups to industrial plants

plastic-injection.title: Plastic Injection & Cap Compression Machines
plastic-injection.description: Our plastic molding machinery portfolio includes injection molding machines for PET preforms and other plastic components, as well as cap compression molding machines for high-speed, high-precision closure production.

statements: To be a trusted partner within our customers' businesses, delivering innovative, high-quality machinery and exceptional after-sales support to empower their growth and success.
To become Africa's leading supplier of liquid packaging solutions, recognized for our advanced technology, reliability, and commitment to excellence.
steps: We begin by thoroughly assessing your requirements and objectives to develop a tailored approach for your production line.
Our team collaborates to create and assemble your machinery, ensuring all aspects meet the highest quality standards.
Utilizing advanced technologies and skilled personnel, we install and commission your production line for optimal performance.
